title: A Causal Perspective on the Role of Training Dynamics for Interpreting Privacy Risks in Code Models
abstract: arXiv:2512.07814v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models for code (LLM4Code) have greatly improved developer productivity but also raise privacy concerns due to their reliance on open-source repositories containing abundant personally identifiable information (PII). Prior work shows that commercial models can reproduce sensitive PII, yet existing studies largely treat PII as a single category and overlook the heterogeneous risks among different types. We investigate whether distinct PII types vary in their likelihood of being learned and leaked by LLM4Code, and whether this relationship is causal. Our methodology includes building a dataset with diverse PII types, fine-tuning representative models of different scales, computing training dynamics on real PII data, and formulating a structural causal model to estimate the causal effect of learnability on leakage. translated_title: 基于因果视角解析训练动态在代码模型隐私风险解释中的作用
translated_abstract: 面向代码的大语言模型（LLM4Code）极大地提升了开发者的生产力，但由于其训练依赖于包含大量个人身份信息（PII）的开源代码库，也引发了隐私方面的担忧。已有研究表明，商业模型能够复现敏感的个人身份信息，然而现有研究大多将PII视为单一类别，忽视了不同类型之间风险的异质性。我们研究了不同类型的PII在被LLM4Code学习和泄露的可能性上是否存在差异，以及这种关系是否具有因果性。我们的研究方法包括：构建一个包含多种PII类型的数据集，微调不同规模的代表性模型，在真实的PII数据上计算训练动态，并构建结构因果模型来估计可学习性对泄露的因果效应。结果表明，不同PII类型之间的泄露风险存在显著差异，且与其训练动态相关（摘要此处被截断）。
tldr: 该研究构建了包含多种PII类型的数据集并结合结构因果模型，首次从因果视角证明了个人身份信息的训练动态（可学习性）因果性地决定了其在代码大模型中被泄露的风险，且不同PII类型的泄露风险存在显著异质性。
